title: Extending an adjoint from an epimorphic generating class
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] and $R:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ an additive functor. Suppose a class $\mathcal P$ of objects of $\mathcal B$ has the following properties: every object of $\mathcal B$ is the target of an epimorphism from an object of $\mathcal P$; and for every $P\in\mathcal P$ there is an object $L_P\in\mathcal A$ and bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(L_P,A)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal B}(P,R(A))$, natural in $A\in\mathcal A$. Then $R$ has a left adjoint $L:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$.
